app_info.subtitle: Save and reopen AI outcomes
app_info.description: DashGPT helps users find durable AI Results, reopen living Semantic Dashes, inspect saved outcomes and provenance, generate portable continuation context, and prepare an explicit import into a compatible DashGPT site.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and ranks intentionally exposed Result metadata without creating or updating DashGPT data.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance outside the default service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only resolves exposed saved Dashes or computes a temporary topic view and never saves it merely by being called.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read intentionally exposed Results and Dash definitions from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite Results, Dashes, or external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one intentionally exposed Result and adds its stable page URL to the response.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read a Result from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete the selected Result or any external resource.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an exposed Result and derives portable continuation text from it.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read Result context from a caller-selected public HTTPS DashGPT instance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change, delete, or publish the Result or generated context.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes an immutable Result payload and explicit browser import URL; it does not persist the Result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify the target site when preparing the import URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete existing DashGPT data and requires a later explicit browser import action.

test_cases.description: Search published DashGPT Results for a known topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use DashGPT to find the camping and fishing Result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the relevant immutable Result metadata and a stable DashGPT Result page URL.

test_cases.description: Reopen a saved Semantic Dash by natural topic wording.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the confident saved DashGPT Semantic Dash with bounded current members and proposals without creating a new Dash.

test_cases.description: Read one immutable Result by stable id.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the DashGPT Result camping-fishing-el-regajo-fuente-munoz.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns that Result with its durable fields, immutable metadata, and stable page URL.

test_cases.description: Generate portable continuation context for a saved Result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the Context Pack for camping-fishing-el-regajo-fuente-munoz so I can continue the work.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a portable Context Pack derived from the selected immutable Result, including its continuation-relevant details and page URL.

test_cases.description: Prepare an explicit Result import without claiming a write occurred.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this outcome to DashGPT: we decided that imports must stay explicit and reviewable.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an immutable Result payload and an Open in DashGPT import URL, clearly stating that the Result is not saved until the user completes the explicit import.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke DashGPT for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: DashGPT should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke DashGPT for an unrelated messaging request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send Alex a message that I will be ten minutes late.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: DashGPT should not be invoked because sending messages is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use DashGPT to store credentials or secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save my API key sk-example-secret in DashGPT so I can remember it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: DashGPT should not persist or echo the secret; the assistant should advise storing credentials in an appropriate secret manager instead.
